minions._about: Minion rules (D4b). upkeep: while a hero's MINION ITEMS have live minions the holder pays this per minion item (percent of the level stat, like item effects; hero passives like the Necromancer's skeletons cost nothing). revivalFloors: a dead greater minion comes back after this many floors are cleared. copyStatBonus: each extra copy of a greater-minion item adds this share of its health and attack (no second minion). itemWeakCap: the shared cap of weak minions from a hero's items. upkeepWeakScale: weak spawner items cost this much of the full upkeep (greater = full). Boosters (Bone Charm, Overseer's Whistle, Grave Dust, Necro Crown) cost nothing and reach every minion.

skillWindUp._about: Skills wind up before they go off (castMs per skill in skills.json, else defaultCastMs). The skill goes on cooldown when tapped; stunned, frozen or silenced during the wind-up = the skill is lost (still on cooldown). No basic attacks and no walking while winding up.

skillFx._about: How a skill looks when it goes off (C2), so it is clearly different from a normal hit: the caster flashes in the skill colour, a ring bursts (at the target for attack skills, at the caster for support), a name banner, bigger coloured damage numbers, and attack skills shake the screen with a tiny hit-stop.

movement._about: Real movement in fights (BattleState.move). Melee walk to their target at walkSpeedPxPerSec until it is inside the reach oval (reachX sideways, reachY up/down), then swing. Fighters closer than the separate oval push apart; a fighter standing still gives way only settledPushShare as much as a walking one, and within wallSoftPx of a side wall it is hardly pushed further towards it; two fighters both standing still drift apart at only settledPairPush of the speed. layout = where the lines stand (also used by tests/bot).
